item.title: [GENERAL] Paramount and Warner Bros. combine video game divisions after $110bn Skydance merger
item.description:
Paramount and Warner Bros.’ video game divisions have been combined, following the $110bn merger between the two companies, which will now be known as Skydance.

The two Hollywood studio giants officially completed their merger on Tuesday, bringing together CNN, HBO, DC Studios, and more under one roof, along with IPs like Harry Potter, Game of Thrones, The Lord of the Rings, and Batman.
